Notes to the Consolidated and Standalone results for the half year ended September 30, 2026:-
1. The above financial results of the company were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on 4th November 2026. The Statutory Auditors of the Company have carried out a limited review of the above results for which they have issued an unmodified opinion.
2. These unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standard notified under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, read with Rule 3 of the Companies (Indian Accounting Standard) Rules, 2015 as amended. It includes the result of the Parent Company and one subsidiary.
3. These results are being published in terms of Regulation 33(3(j) of the listing obligations and disclosure requirements, 2015 as amended from time to time.
4. The company operations predominantly comprise of only one segment i.e., manufacturing of various kinds/types of Plastic Moulded Products which is considered as the only business segment. Accordingly, no separate disclosures of segment information have been made.
5. During the quarter ended 30th September 2026, the Company has completed its Initial Public Offer (IPO) of 2,91,86,045 equity shares of face value of Rs. 2 each at an issue price of Rs. 43 per share, aggregating to Rs. 1255 Million. Pursuant to IPO, the equity shares of the Company were listed on National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) and BSE Limited (BSE) on 21st September 2026. The issue comprised of offer for sale of 76,74,418 Equity Shares by selling shareholders aggregating to Rs. 330 Million and fresh issue of 2,15,11,627 equity shares aggregating to Rs. 925 Million. Accordingly, these unaudited financial results for the half year ended 30 September 2026 have been drawn up for the first time in accordance with the Listing Regulations.
6. The company has incurred an expenditure of Rs 107.78 Million (Net of amounts recovered from selling shareholders) including Rs 80.68 Million during the half year under review in relation to the IPO. The same has been charged to Securities Premium account.
7. The financial results for the quarter ended 30th June 2026 and quarter ended 30th September 2025 were audited in connection with the IPO of the company. The figures for the said quarters, wherever included are based on such audit carried out.
8. The results for the quarter ended September 30,2025 were approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on November 04,2026 and have neither been audited nor been reviewed.
9. The aforesaid financial results of the company are being forwarded to the Stock Exchange (BSE and NSE) for uploading on their respective websites and the same is also made available on the company's website viz., www.manikaplastech.com
